findings.issue: Heteronym: /bəˈfeɪ/ covers the meal sense; the listed 打击/冲击 sense is /ˈbʌfɪt/. One IPA cannot cover both.
findings.context: The hotel serves a cold buffet at lunch.

findings.context: The businesswoman runs her own company.

result.notes: Reviewed all 215 entries. Most entries use a simplified American transcription (/e/ for /eɪ/, /o/ for /oʊ/) and omitted length marks; these conventions were not flagged. Stress-shift noun/verb pairs such as import/export, update, and download/upload are transcribed in the verb form matching the supplied meanings; no error was recorded for them. Entry 3414 Britain's example appears corrupted ('This is the stud  naturalized from Britain.') and needs editorial cleanup. No audio was supplied, so no audio observations are made.
